In detail

A large, mixed residential-industrial district named in the July 2025 citywide theft-hotspot map. The same 2023 comparison of five inner districts (V, VII, VIII, IX, X) found Kőbánya had the single highest crime density per capita of the five, ahead of Ferencváros and Józsefváros. Sources checked: Jozsefvarosujsag.hu, 10 Jul 2023 (five-district crime-density comparison); Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
